audit_result.proof_trace: `flash_loan_withdraw` only calls `underlying_balance.split(amount)` and does NOT decrement `self.cash`, unlike `withdraw_underlying` (L312: `self.cash = self.cash - amount`). This makes `self.cash` appear inflated by the flash loan amount during the flash loan window. Since `exchange_rate() = (debt + cash - cash_reserve) / total_supply` (L92-101) and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` (market.move:1275) uses `reserve.exchange_rate().mul(ctoken_amount)` for collateral valuation, cToken collateral of the flash-loaned asset is over-valued during the window. `handle_borrow` (market.move:366) does not check `flash_loan_ongoing`, so a regular borrow can execute in the same PTB using inflated collateral values.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A caller with flash_loan `PackageCallerCap` permission executes a PTB: (1) `borrow_flash_loan(A, F)` — self.cash stays at X instead of dropping to X-F; (2) `borrow(B, excess)` — `is_obligation_safe` uses inflated `exchange_rate(A)`, passing the safety check for more B than actual collateral supports; (3) `repay_flash_loan(A, F+fee)` — position is now under-collateralized with excess B retained.

PROP-current-fina-inv-005.text: Flash loan borrow must not increment reserve.debt; only reserve.cash is temporarily reduced.
